metrics.duplicate_extra_rows: For identical session_id, timestamp, event_name, analytics_storage, and properties, count every copy after the first; event_id is ignored.
metrics.invalid_event_name_rows: Count in-scope rows whose event_name does not match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.
metrics.missing_required_property_rows: After applying event_aliases, count in-scope rows for which at least one property listed for that event is absent, null, or blank.
metrics.pii_property_rows: Count in-scope rows containing any forbidden property key at any nesting depth.
metrics.pre_consent_rows: Count in-scope rows whose analytics_storage is not granted.

scope: Only rows where traffic_type is external are included in every QA summary metric.
